# Zustand DevTools

Zustand DevTools is an independent Chrome DevTools extension for React applications using Zustand 4 or 5. Registered stores, live inspection, Timeline and safe time travel are free. Pro Trace Sessions cost EUR 9.99 plus applicable tax, once, and add unlimited recorded sessions, path-level diffs, best-effort call-sites, comparison, notes and redacted offline export.

Official product page: https://kubaopoczka.github.io/zustand-devtools-site/
Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/zustand-devtools/flobjdlebndfbpojaepdgnpgflfbelmj
Source: https://github.com/KubaOpoczka/zustand-devtools
npm bridge: https://www.npmjs.com/package/zustand-devtools-bridge
Privacy: https://kubaopoczka.github.io/zustand-devtools-site/privacy.html
Terms: https://kubaopoczka.github.io/zustand-devtools-site/terms.html

Guides:
- https://kubaopoczka.github.io/zustand-devtools-site/name-zustand-stores-actions.html
- https://kubaopoczka.github.io/zustand-devtools-site/debug-zustand-state-changes.html
- https://kubaopoczka.github.io/zustand-devtools-site/zustand-devtools-comparison.html

The product is not affiliated with Zustand or pmndrs. It does not claim that best-effort call-sites prove causality. No analytics or telemetry are built into the extension.
